title: 2001 HMMT February Guts Problem 15
statement: A beaver walks from \((0,0)\) to \((4,4)\) in the plane, walking one unit in the positive \(x\) direction or one unit in the positive \(y\) direction at each step. Moreover, he never goes to a point \((x, y)\) with \(y>x\). How many different paths can he walk?
